summary: Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience building large-scale data platforms and real-time pipelines processing millions of transactions and large-volume datasets across financial services, healthcare, and retail domains. Expert in Python, SQL, and PySpark with deep experience in Apache Spark, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, and Azure for distributed data processing, streaming systems, and cloud-native data engineering.

Proven track record of architecting scalable data lakes and warehouses across AWS, Azure, and Snowflake. Strong expertise in dimensional modeling (Star Schema, SCD Type 2), medallion architecture, dbt, data quality, governance, and performance optimization. In my current role at Fidelity Investments, I support AI/ML-driven analytics by engineering high-quality trading and market datasets for anomaly detection, risk analysis, and predictive modeling.
